en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning issued as temperatures climb past 33C
en.dek: The Observatory raised the warning at 1pm, urging the public to watch for heat stroke while the Yellow Fire Danger Warning remains in force.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Very Hot Weather Warning at 1pm on Saturday, warning that very hot conditions were expected across the territory.

Temperatures in many districts rose above 33 degrees in the afternoon, with Yuen Long Park recording 35 degrees earlier. The Observatory advised the public to drink more water, avoid prolonged outdoor exertion and take rest in the shade if feeling unwell. Elderly people, pregnant women, infants, those with chronic illnesses and the obese were identified as more vulnerable.
The Yellow Fire Danger Warning, issued at 6am, remains in force, indicating a high fire risk. Hikers were reminded to stay alert and prevent fires.
The forecast for the rest of Saturday and Sunday points to mainly fine, dry and very hot weather, with isolated showers possible later on Sunday.

zh.headline: 天文台發出酷熱天氣警告 多區氣溫逾33度
zh.dek: 警告於下午1時發出，黃色火災危險警告仍生效；市民應多補充水分，慎防中暑。
body: 香港天文台於周六下午1時發出酷熱天氣警告，預料本港天氣酷熱。
下午多區氣溫升至33度或以上，元朗公園早前更錄得35度。天文台呼籲市民多補充水分，避免過度勞累，如感不適應盡快到陰涼地方休息。長者、孕婦、嬰兒及小童、慢性病患者及過胖人士較易中暑，應特別留意。
早上6時發出的黃色火災危險警告仍然生效，表示火警風險高，郊遊人士須小心防火。
天文台預料周六晚至周日大致天晴、乾燥及酷熱，周日稍後局部地區可能有驟雨。
